create_SimSINBase_dataset: create a SimSINBase PyTorch dataset instance with data path, filenames, height, width, frame indices, and num scales
implement_get_color_method: implement the get_color abstract method in a SimSINBase subclass to load and return color images from disk
implement_get_depth_method: implement the get_depth abstract method in a SimSINBase subclass to load and return ground truth depth maps
preprocess_color_images: call preprocess on a SimSINBase instance to resize color images across scales and apply color augmentation
getitem_dataset_sample: call getitem on a SimSINBase dataset to retrieve a dictionary of color images, camera intrinsics, and depth ground truth
